reports.clinical: 49-year-old man referred for assessment of a lymphoproliferative disorder. No extranodal disease. Cervical and axillary lymphadenopathy (nodes up to 2.8 cm). Splenomegaly (spleen 24 cm on ultrasound). B symptoms (night sweats and weight loss). Full blood count: Hb 143 g/L, WBC 9.9 x10^9/L, neutrophils 3.8 x10^9/L, platelets 301 x10^9/L; no cytopenias. Clonal B-cell count 3.2 x10^9/L.
reports.morphology: Lymph node excision biopsy. A follicular growth pattern with back-to-back neoplastic follicles is seen. The infiltrate comprises predominantly centrocytes with scattered centroblasts. Immunohistochemistry: BCL6 positive, BCL2 expression positive, cyclin D1 negative. Ki-67 approximately 57%. Reported by LT/AO, 16 Jan 2026.
